paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the training and validation accuracy over 30 epochs for a machine learning model, with the x-axis labeled “Epoch” ranging from 0 to 30 in linear increments and the y-axis labeled “Accuracy (%)” ranging from 40 to 100 in linear increments. The blue solid line with no markers represents the training accuracy, which begins near 45%, fluctuates significantly in the early epochs (dropping as low as ~42% around epoch 11), then rises sharply after epoch 15, reaching approximately 99% by epoch 25 and plateauing near 100% by epoch 30. The green solid line with no markers represents the validation accuracy, which starts near 47%, also exhibits early fluctuations (dropping to ~42% around epoch 11), then gradually increases with smaller oscillations, reaching approximately 82% by epoch 30. Both lines show a general upward trend after epoch 15, though the training accuracy consistently exceeds the validation accuracy after epoch 10, indicating potential overfitting. The plot includes a legend in the upper left corner identifying the blue line as “Train” and the green line as “Validation,” and features a light gray grid for easier reading of values.
